استقبلن (form X)
# اِسْتَقْبَلْنَ (istaqbalna) /is.taq.bal.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَقْبَلَ (istaqbala)
# اُسْتُقْبِلْنَ (ustuqbilna) /us.tuq.bil.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَقْبَلَ (istaqbala)
# اِسْتَقْبِلْنَ (istaqbilna) /is.taq.bil.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَقْبَلَ (istaqbala)
